description: Painted sprite parts for the patrol queen, the powdered-wig royal (?art=paint). Same three steps as paint-rebel-pawn.json; then tools/art/cut-parts.mjs. The crown on the wig is an owner correction (the reference has none) so the queen crest reads at 48px.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite of the royal patrol QUEEN from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style or its wig shape. SUBJECT: a haughty royal queen. A towering powdered pale blue-white beehive wig, much taller than it is wide (about 1.3 times as tall as wide), built from stacked ridged rolls with bold dark ridge lines between them and a domed top, draped with two swags of gold beads and pearls hanging from a blue jewel at the front. A gold crown with five tall points and a blue gem sits on the very top of the wig, about half as wide as the wig. Under the wig a small steel cap over a clear round skin face, as wide as the cap, with two black dot eyes and small red lips. Behind her neck a tall stiff WHITE fan collar edged with a thin gold rim, opening out like a fan on both sides of her head (pure white with pale blue shading, not tan, not beige, not lace). A royal-blue gown: the bell skirt is solid royal blue all the way across the front, with NO vertical stripes, NO centre panel and NO gold on it except one gold hem band at the bottom; the bodice is royal blue with a narrow gold stomacher strip that stops at the waist. Big round puffed blue sleeves with gold stripes standing out wide at her shoulders, white gloves. A slim gold sceptre topped with a round blue jewelled orb and a small gold cross, held upright in her right fist on the right side of the figure: her gloved fist is clearly wrapped round the sceptre's rod, fingers visibly gripping it, and the orb rises to about the height of the wig's middle. The sceptre is thin, the orb no wider than her face. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the wig, crown and head together are about half the figure's height. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal and pearls, polished royal blue with gold trim. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.

steps.name: parts
steps.prompt:
Cut this exact character into separate parts for a 2D cut-out puppet, like a paper-doll sprite sheet. Keep her exact art style, colours, outline thickness and shading. Draw each part whole and complete, including the bits that are normally hidden behind other parts, and give every part its own very thick black outline all the way round. The parts are separate stickers with wide empty gaps between them, every part at the same scale as in the first image, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8). The image holds only these parts and nothing else: no other characters, no tiles, no text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no cast shadows.

Layout, exactly:
- Top row, left: the HEAD: the towering ridged beehive wig with its pearl and gold swags and the small gold crown on top, the steel cap, and the face under it. The face is plain blank skin with NO eyes and no eyebrows, only the red lips. The head ends at the chin, no neck, no collar.
- Top row, middle: the BODY: the royal-blue gown (blue bodice and a solid blue skirt with no centre stripe) with the narrow gold stomacher and gold hem and the white fan collar rising behind the neck, with no arms and no head; a short skin neck stump at the top.
- Top row, right: the BACK ARM (her left arm): a puffed blue sleeve with a gold stripe hanging down to a white gloved hand.
- Bottom row, left: the FRONT ARM (her right arm): a puffed blue sleeve with a gold stripe from the shoulder, bent at the elbow, ending in a closed white gloved fist that points to the right, curled as if round a rod.
- Bottom row, middle: empty.
- Right edge, spanning from top to bottom: the SCEPTRE on its own, standing straight up, orb at the top, whole and not held.
